description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Prosper's last ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
